name: Gelatin
origin: Made by boiling the skin, bones and connective tissue of cattle or pigs.

name: Carmine (Cochineal)
origin: A red dye made by crushing cochineal beetles.

name: Lanolin
origin: Grease extracted from sheep's wool.

name: Beeswax
origin: Wax secreted by honeybees to build their honeycomb.

name: Honey
origin: Made by bees from flower nectar - not vegan, even though many vegans still eat it varies by belief; this site treats it as animal-derived.

name: Shellac
origin: A resin secreted by the female lac beetle.

name: Casein
origin: A protein extracted from cow's milk.

name: Whey
origin: A by-product of cow's milk left over from cheesemaking.

name: Collagen
origin: A protein taken from animal skin, bones, tendons or connective tissue (usually cattle, pigs or fish).

name: Keratin
origin: A protein taken from animal hair, horns, feathers or hooves.

name: Elastin
origin: A protein taken from the neck ligaments and aortas of cattle.

name: Tallow
origin: Rendered fat from cattle or sheep.

name: Lard
origin: Rendered fat from pigs.

name: Squalene
origin: Traditionally extracted from shark liver oil. ("Squalane" and "phytosqualane" are usually plant-derived instead - see the note below if that's what you scanned.)

name: Guanine (Pearl Essence)
origin: A shimmer additive scraped from fish scales.

name: Glycerin
origin: Usually made from plant oils today, but can also be rendered from animal fat - the label alone can't tell you which, so this brand's own vegan claim is what to check.

name: Stearic Acid
origin: Usually made from palm or soy oil today, but historically and sometimes still rendered from cattle or pig fat - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Cetyl/Stearyl Alcohol
origin: Usually made from plant oils (coconut/palm) today, but can be made from spermaceti (whale oil) or other animal fats - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Oleic Acid
origin: Usually from plant oils today, but can be rendered from animal fat - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Lecithin
origin: Usually from soy or sunflower today, but can also come from egg yolk - check the brand's vegan claim if it doesn't specify "soy lecithin" or "sunflower lecithin".

name: Vitamin D3
origin: Usually made from lanolin (sheep's wool grease) or fish oil. ("Vitamin D2"/ergocalciferol is plant-derived instead.)

name: Retinol
origin: Can be synthesised or sourced from animal liver/fish oil - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Silk
origin: Made from the cocoons of silkworms.

name: Allantoin
origin: Usually synthesised or from comfrey plants today, but can be extracted from cattle urine - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Chitosan
origin: Usually made from shellfish shells (crab, shrimp, lobster).

name: Hyaluronic Acid
origin: Modern versions are usually fermented (vegan), but older/cheaper versions can be extracted from rooster combs or animal connective tissue - check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Ambergris
origin: A waxy substance from sperm whale intestines, used in perfume.

name: Musk/Civet
origin: Traditionally taken from the scent glands of musk deer or civet cats - modern fragrance almost always uses synthetic substitutes, but check if unspecified.

name: Egg
origin: Made from chicken eggs.

name: Milk
origin: From cows, goats or sheep.

name: Propolis
origin: A resin-like substance bees make from plant sap and their own secretions.

name: Royal Jelly
origin: A secretion produced by worker honeybees to feed larvae and the queen.

name: Carminic Acid
origin: The colour compound extracted from cochineal beetles (same source as carmine).

name: Spermaceti
origin: Waxy oil found in the head cavities of sperm whales. (Now largely banned/replaced, but still worth flagging if the label uses the old name.)
